description.zh: 由容器管理的 openclaw gateway（自带最新版），主界面内嵌打开 Control UI；配置在 ~/.openclaw
description.en: Container-managed openclaw gateway (bundled latest); the Control UI opens embedded in the main window; config lives in ~/.openclaw

description.en: Leave empty to follow the environment directory (env/openclaw under the install dir by default)
